name: distributed-gitignore-python-cache
title: Distributed gitignore block omits Python bytecode caches it causes
description: The gitignore block the installer writes into every consumer (installer/fileops.py:450-469, from four non-contiguous tuples at installer/registry.py:1922, :1967, :1974, :1982) has no Python bytecode-cache pattern, while the pack installs 18 Python scripts into each consumer's scripts/. Running one directly writes scripts/__pycache__/, which nothing ignores; it surfaced three times in one loadsmith session and twice blocked git worktree remove without --force. The pack already treats the cache as a byproduct everywhere else -- its own .gitignore:7-8, update-spec-kb.py:131, and install-audit.py:264 -- and Trellis's own .trellis/.gitignore carries the pattern but scopes it to .trellis/. The sanctioned toolchain.sh entry point sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, which is why this stayed invisible. Add the patterns to the block's source tuples, deciding placement and pattern form rather than defaulting them.
